extracted.name: Round Steak and Gravy II
extracted.description: Succulent round steak seared, then braised in cream of mushroom and French onion soups until tender. Great with mashed potatoes, as it makes it’s own gravy.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed French onion soup
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Trim the fat from the steak, and cut into desired number of servings.
In a roasting pan over medium high heat, sear both sides of the steak, about 1 minute per side. Remove from heat.
Stir the cream of mushroom soup, French onion soup and water into the roaster. Bake in the preheated oven 2 1/2 hours.
